title: SiT
paper_title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-Based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers
core_mech: SiT 将 DiT 放入 stochastic interpolant 框架，用统一模型显式比较 velocity、score 和 diffusion 参数化。
core_mech_en: Places the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone inside a continuous-time Stochastic Interpolant framework to systematically decouple interpolation schedules, model targets, and samplers.
input_desc: 数据样本 x0、噪声 ε、连续时间 t 和可选类别条件
input_en: Data sample x_0 (or latent), Gaussian noise ε, continuous time t ∈ [0,1], and conditioning label c
output_desc: 学习到的 velocity/score/noise 场及 ODE/SDE 生成样本
output_en: Samples generated via configurable deterministic ODE or stochastic SDE integrators from the same SiT backbone

adapter.name: SiT
adapter.mechanism: Original SiT Transformer with velocity regression on its linear stochastic-interpolant path.
limitations: Two blocks on pixels; no pretrained VAE or alternative score/noise parameterizations and SDE samplers.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
